fees.joining_note: A one-time joining fee of ₹1000 is charged at the time of card issuance as per the bank's policy.
fees.annual_note: The annual fee is charged every year and may be waived if you meet the bank's spending conditions.
fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹1 lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 3.5% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency.Examples (3.5%):₹100 → ₹3.5₹1,000 → ₹35₹10,000 → ₹350₹1,00,000 → ₹3,500
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card, subject to a minimum of ₹500.
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: Railway ticket bookings made using this card attract a surcharge of 1% of the transaction amount plus applicable GST, as charged by Indian Railways / payment gateway
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Late payment charges apply if the Minimum Amount Due (MAD) is not paid by the due date. Charges are based on the total outstanding amount as per the slab structure above.
